steps.title: Get ready
steps.body: Clear your workspace and make sure you can see all of the parts on the table.

steps.title: Find the parts
steps.body: Look around the table. Detected objects are labeled in your view.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Attach part A to part B, then tighten until snug.

steps.title: Check your work
steps.body: Confirm everything is secure, then press Finish.
